svg.title: SSC-7 engine Ramp shapes, before and after
svg.desc: Four vanilla engine pitch Ramps and the three Ramp shapes, as evaluated by ssc-curves.js at 4bc1f4603 and at faa39811f.
svg.text: Six-parameter engine Ramps: straight lines before, curves after (SSC-7)
Pitch multiplier against normalised revs, evaluated by ssc-curves.js modulatorValue from each commit.
Ramp p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6: p5 picks the shape (0 linear, 1 quick, 2 slow), p6 is its exponent.
Vanilla engines shown are from the
Wake and Battle of Britain scene.json.
